entities.summary: Randal Alexander Grichuk is an American professional baseball outfielder for the New York Yankees of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the St. Louis Cardinals, Toronto Blue Jays, Colorado Rockies, Los Angeles Angels, Arizona Diamondbacks, and Kansas City Royals.
